verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for email-marketing platforms, since self-hostable alternatives exist in the category, so the story applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Moosend can be deployed on user infrastructure. The pack describes only a hosted SaaS with subscription plans, and its 'securely host files' feature covers campaign asset hosting, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
